keep.text: A voucher works for 60 minutes from its first use, on up to 3 devices, until 1000 MB have gone through it.

readme_rule.why: follows the out-of-date README.md: 60 minutes from the first use, 3 devices, 1000 MB

data_3_gb.why: guesses a round 3 GB (3072 MB) of data a voucher instead of 2965 MB

minutes_inclusive.why: off by one: still lets a device on exactly 92 minutes after the voucher's first use

readme_devices.why: takes the chat's new time and data limits but keeps README.md's 3 devices
